data.text:
My family taught me to protect the lake and look after our neighbors. I’ll join Emma: I commit to catching 15 tons this month and donating the full $15,000 to the clinic today, provided John and Kate also commit to 15 and Luke keeps his catch at zero.

I’ll share my catch record and donation receipt. If we begin next month with 80 tons, I’ll take 6 tons under the agreed recovery cap; after recovery, let’s agree on 10 tons each per month to keep the lake healthy and our livelihoods secure. John, can you commit to this emergency plan?
